title: Give
generosity_paragraph: Your generosity sustains our Sunday gatherings, midweek ministries, and local outreach, and helps renew our building for future mission. Thank you for giving to St John's.
methods_heading: Here are the best ways for you to give:
methods: Via the Online Parish Giving Scheme.
Bring your collection to church on Sunday.
Use the card machine at church.
If you are giving specifically towards building development, please include the reference BUILDING where possible.

development_needs.heading: Current Building Development Needs
development_needs.intro: From Buildings Masterplan Revision 1 (January 2026), these Phase 1 projects are our immediate priorities:
items: Spire repairs, bird clearance, and long-term bird protection.
Gutter clearance and a high-level roof condition survey to reduce water-damage risk.
East gable external repairs to address ongoing water ingress.
Extension roof concrete repairs (funding secured, works expected in the coming months).
Replacement extension windows to improve safety, warmth, and suitability for Kids' Church and Foodbank.
